banner.service_paused: Company service is paused — synced content only
banner.sync_pending: {count} meeting texts pending sync to company server
banner.sync_error: Some content failed to sync and will be retried automatically
banner.ai_off: AI assistant is off — contact your admin

service_switch.label: Company service
service_switch.paused_hint: Once paused, employees already signed in can still read synced content but cannot edit; new sign-ins are blocked until the service is re-enabled.

encryption.title: Access encryption (HTTPS)
encryption.current_http: Current: plain HTTP inside your intranet — colleagues’ meeting texts could be intercepted.
encryption.benefit: Once enabled, meeting texts are encrypted in transit on your intranet; ~2 minutes of setup plus a one-time root certificate import per device.
encryption.guide_cmd: Set TLS_MODE=internal-ca in the .env under deploy/private, run docker compose up -d oms-proxy; then install the root certificate from the ca/ folder on each device (macOS / Windows import scripts included).

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.current_off: AI assistant is off: minutes are generated on each employee's own machine; meeting texts are never sent to any external AI service.
ai.current_on: AI assistant is on: only the domains below are reachable.
ai.egress_notice: Enabling this allows meeting texts to be sent to the endpoint above — exactly why enterprise ships zero-egress by default. The allowlist is enforced at the server network layer.
ai.credential_note: Used only for the AI egress feature; stored on the company server, unrelated to API keys on employees’ own machines.

users.invite_shown_hint: Send it to your colleague. They set their own password via “Accept Invitation” on the login page. You never handle any password.
users.reset_sent: Old sessions revoked; a new invite code was issued (shown once below)
users.delete_confirm_hint: Deletes this employee's entire server-side meeting text archive (audio and voiceprints were never on the server). Type the account name {account} to confirm.

data.title: Data & backup
data.promise_line1: Backups stay only on the company's own server
data.promise_line3: Never uploaded to any external cloud
data.backup_guide: Backup and rollback are executed by the DevOps deliverables (backup-snapshot + compose two-version rollback); P0 offers no in-UI backup operations.
data.server_text_overview: The server stores finalized text only: transcript, minutes, decision flow, notes, glossary.

assistant.title: Local recording assistant
assistant.disconnected: No recording assistant on this computer yet
assistant.disconnected_hint: You can still work without it: view and edit existing meeting texts normally; only new recordings require the assistant.
assistant.download_guide: Download the recording assistant from the company server (offline package, no internet needed)
assistant.connected_unpaired: Assistant online, no account bound yet
assistant.unpaired_desc: Open the recording assistant on this computer and enter the pairing code below to start recording.
assistant.pairing_hint: The code is valid for {minutes} minutes and shown only once.
assistant.download_hint: Downloaded from the company server (offline package, no internet needed) — the link is provisioned by your admin deployment.
assistant.migrate_confirm: Recording data is copied to the new folder you choose. The original folder is left untouched; after the copy is verified, you decide when to clean up the old files.
assistant.migrate_done: Migration complete. After restarting the local recording assistant, the new folder location takes effect. Files in the original folder remain unchanged.
assistant.migrate_note: Folder change applies after the assistant restarts
assistant.migrate_rejected: Choose a folder that differs from and does not nest with the current one

data_location.title: Where data lives
data_location.readonly_hint: Read-only: the P0 sync scope is fixed by the admin's deployment and cannot be toggled per user.
data_location.row3_content: Finalized meeting text (transcript, minutes, decisions, notes, glossary)

library.title: My meetings
library.empty: No meetings yet — let the local assistant record your first meeting

detail.conflict_reload: Content changed elsewhere; reloaded latest — please re-apply your edits
detail.audio_local: Audio stays on the recording device

assets.hotwords_guide: Hot words are edited on computers with the local recording assistant. This shows the latest version stored on your company server.
assets.speakers_guide: Speaker naming and voiceprint binding happen on computers with the local recording assistant. This shows the latest alias mapping from your company server.
assets.empty: Nothing uploaded from your assistant devices yet
